mapper.select: SELECT PC.post_category_id AS post_category_id , PC.name AS name , PC.sort_order AS sort_order , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wimb.post_base WHERE category_id = PC.post_category_id) AS post_count FROM wimb.post_category PC WHERE PC.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY PC.sort_order ASC
SELECT post_category_id FROM wimb.post_category WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wimb.post_category WHERE post_category_id = #{postCategoryId} AND user_id = #{userId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wimb.post_category WHERE name = #{name} AND user_id = #{userId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wimb.post_category WHERE name = #{name} AND user_id = #{userId} AND post_category_id != #{postCategoryId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wimb.post_category WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT MAX(sort_order) FROM wimb.post_category WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE wimb.post_category SET sort_order = sort_order - 1 , updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sort_order > (SELECT sort_order FROM wimb.post_category WHERE post_category_id = #{deletingPostCategoryId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wimb.post_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_category_id = #{postCategoryId}
